audience: class-based schools and clubs with the Jackrabbit Labs Customer API enabled

useCases.title: Find classes with openings
useCases.text: Browse available classes and inspect their schedules, capacity, tuition and age limits.

useCases.title: Review a class roster and attendance
useCases.text: Read a class roster and find recorded attendance or makeup details for a student over a chosen period.

useCases.title: Look up a family and its contacts
useCases.text: Find a family account, inspect its details and check the contacts authorized to pick up a student.

useCases.title: Inspect a student’s enrollments
useCases.text: Read a student’s record and inspect existing or future-dated class enrollments.

useCases.title: Add an existing student to a waitlist
useCases.text: Check the class and its waitlist, then add the student when requested. This creates a waitlist entry and does not enroll the student.
